scenarios.name: go-coupon-sync-bug
scenarios.title: Stuck Sync-Lock Debugging
scenarios.goal: Debug a coupon syncer where one API failure permanently wedges the in-flight lock and aborts the whole batch. Fix sync.go only; tests are read-only.
scenarios.signal: Root-cause debugging, not feature writing: two interacting bugs (early return skips lock release, one bad coupon halts the batch) mirror a real cart gift-sync incident. Hidden concurrency tests catch superficial fixes.

scenarios.name: go-currency-market
scenarios.title: Currency & Market Mapping
scenarios.goal: Implement ISO 4217 minor-unit money formatting (0/2/3 decimal currencies, negatives) and currency-to-country market mapping from a written spec.
scenarios.signal: Pure spec-to-code fidelity under fintech edge cases: JPY has no decimals, KWD has three, -70 cents must render -0.70. Models that skim the spec fail on exponent edge cases.

scenarios.name: go-graphql-optional-field
scenarios.title: Optional GraphQL Field Fallback
scenarios.goal: Query an optional GraphQL field for market support, but degrade gracefully when the API version rejects it: retry once without the field, propagate every other error.
scenarios.signal: Recreates a real 3-day production outage: an agent added presentmentCurrencies to a discount query, older API versions rejected the whole query, and the handler swallowed the failure. Tests schema-evolution defensiveness — distinguishing 'field not supported' from real errors and never silently succeeding.

scenarios.name: go-portlist
scenarios.title: lsof Output Parser
scenarios.goal: Parse raw `lsof -F pcn` field output into structured listeners: pid/command blocks with multiple addresses, IPv6 brackets, malformed lines, and exact-duplicate dedupe.
scenarios.signal: Real-world messy-text parsing from a dev-tools CLI. Punishes models that pattern-match a happy path instead of reading the field format: stateful blocks, skip rules, and order preservation trip up weaker models.

scenarios.name: go-webhook-retry
scenarios.title: Webhook Retry Semantics
scenarios.goal: Fix a Shopify-style webhook handler that returns HTTP 200 even when processing fails, and rejects nothing on HMAC mismatch.
scenarios.signal: Distilled from a real production incident where broken discount syncs went silent for 3 days. Tests whether a model understands delivery/retry contracts and auth-before-processing — not just making code compile. The most discriminating task in the suite.

scenarios.name: js-cart-progress
scenarios.title: Cart Free-Shipping Widget
scenarios.goal: Implement a free-shipping progress bar state machine and money formatter for a vanilla-JS Shopify cart drawer, handling disabled thresholds and NaN input.
scenarios.signal: Baseline sanity check for defensive frontend logic. Nearly every competent model passes; a failure here is a red flag rather than a differentiator.
